title: Suggested reviewer ordering and human-edit precedence in agentic report persistence
answers: Why did research overwrite the reviewer I set on an inbox report?
In what order are suggested reviewers chosen for a signals report?
Where do CODEOWNERS and owners.yaml owners get merged with commit authors?
body:
Suggested reviewers are ordered: owners.yaml owner, then a different CODEOWNERS owner, then commit-author fallbacks, capped at MAX_SUGGESTED_REVIEWERS (products/signals/backend/temporal/agentic/report.py:_build_reviewers_content).
Human edits win: `_append_agentic_report_artefacts` locks the SignalReport row (select_for_update) and skips any SuggestedReviewers draft if a SUGGESTED_REVIEWERS artefact with actor_kind=USER already exists. Skipping the lock/check lets later research runs replace a person's choice.
It returns `wrote_reviewers`; `_persist_agentic_report_artefacts` only fires `capture_suggested_reviewers_resolved` when that is true, so keep the event tied to an actual write.
Ownership matching lives in products/signals/backend/report_generation/ownership_reviewers.py:suggest_repository_owners; it yields at most one reviewer per source (owners.yaml / CODEOWNERS) and prefers logins already among commit-author reviewers.
